verdict.rationale: Docs list 100+ supported models spanning text, vision, audio, image, and embeddings, and explicitly call out vision models for image/document analysis, showing multimodal capability beyond text chat on the same platform. However, evidence lacks explicit audio and image-generation model examples/endpoints or hands-on confirmation of these modalities working. Missing for 10: concrete audio model docs/examples, image-generation endpoint documentation, and independent/hands-on verification of non-text modalities.
